name: Genesis G70
author: Lucas.Karlsmoen
modelYear: Pre-facelift generation; exact original model year and trim not specified by the artist. Published before the 2020 facelift.
redistributorLicense: Dataset ODC-By 1.0; this individual object CC BY 4.0. Both the archive metadata and GLB asset.extras retain the original author, source UID and license.
changes: Simplified geometry with tight error limits for external painted panels, glazing and trim; heavier reduction only for small details, plus a separate Canvas fallback mesh.
Converted source +Y forward / Z up to renderer +X forward / +Y right / +Z up; placed lowest tire point at zero.
Preserved original lamp/wheel textures and UVs.
Recolored untextured white tire material as rubber, used dark opaque cabin glazing, omitted concealed beige interior and adapted metal/lamp materials to the renderer.

Preserved the original front diamond grille lattice and refined source rear-skirt/exhaust detail. Separated grille supports and exhaust cavities from metallic rims, body-painted mirror caps from black undersides, glossy black B-pillars and dark-chrome window perimeter frames without moving vertices.
attribution: Genesis G70 by Lucas.Karlsmoen (Sketchfab), licensed CC BY 4.0. Retrieved from AllenAI Objaverse; geometry and materials adapted for WebSim. No manufacturer endorsement implied.

conversion.quality: Main mesh preserves the original 33,915-triangle grille lattice. Exterior chrome, mirror/pillar pieces and rear exhaust/diffuser use ratio 0.25 / relative error 0.00012. Original painted panels, lamp/wheel/glass buffers and textures are unchanged. Material groups are split without moving vertices. The 4,689-triangle Canvas fallback retains its original coarse geometry and has lower grille fidelity.
conversion.validation: Dedicated geometry/material/provenance regressions and final production WebGL front, side, rear, red-body and fallback captures reviewed on 2026-10-20. No driving physics or vehicle specifications changed.

visualReferences.purpose: Pre-facelift identity and selective finish/detail review; independent artist geometry retained, not manufacturer CAD.
